remarks: LOCATION! LOCATION! LOCATION! 2802 Summer St Ste 4 Stamford, CT. A remarkable opportunity to acquire this Fully renovated restaurant featuring newly designed, code-compliant infrastructure in the Ridgeway, Stamford. This thoughtfully designed establishment maximizes every inch of space and includes seating for 6-8 tables, a high-capacity pizza oven that fits up to 25 pies, 3 freezers, a walk-in refrigerator, commercial mixer, range and a full basement with additional storage. Excellent opportunity for growth with strong takeout and catering potential. Located on a lively Stamford street surrounded by restaurants, shopping and hundreds of young professionals. Plenty of parking and outstanding visibility make this a must-see opportunity.
